source_summary: Monumental vertical Chinese landscape with mist-filled mountains, pine-covered rocky terraces, small pavilions, bridges, travelers, and river boats rendered in dark ink linework and washes over warm ochre tones.

motifs.name: upper_misty_cliff_peaks
motifs.description: Isolate the distant upper mountain range: ghostly left spires, the dark central vertical cliff mass, and the jagged crag cluster to the upper right, including only the surrounding mist openings that define their silhouettes.
must_preserve: jagged ink outlines of the crags
dry-brush rock texture and vertical fissures
dense dotted foliage on cliff tops and ledges
soft diluted wash fading into mist
irregular mist edges cutting through the mountain forms

motifs.name: left_cliff_pines_pavilion
motifs.description: Isolate the left middle rocky terrace with sweeping old pines, exposed roots, layered rocks, shrubs, and the small pavilion roof tucked among the branches.
must_preserve: twisting pine trunks and exposed root lines
fine clustered pine needles on horizontal boughs
small pavilion roof geometry with curved eaves
stepped rock ledges and ink wash shadows
tiny shrubs and stippled vegetation around the terrace

motifs.name: central_mist_water_basin
motifs.description: Isolate the open central mist-and-water basin between the cliffs and foreground slopes, including faint islets, submerged rock silhouettes, horizontal wash bands, and pale cloud-like voids.
must_preserve: soft horizontal water-wash texture
blurred silhouettes of low islets and rocks
feathered mist edges
subtle warm ochre tonal transitions
faint ink accents that suggest depth without hard outlines

motifs.name: right_mid_hillside_pines
motifs.description: Isolate the right middle hillside with pine clusters, low shrubs, sloping rocks, faint reeds or willow-like verticals, and small human activity near the water edge, excluding the larger bridge below.
must_preserve: layered pine canopies with needle clusters
slanted hillside contour lines
scattered rocks and stippled brush texture
faint vertical reed or willow strokes near the shore
tiny figure linework where visible

motifs.name: right_arch_bridge_figures
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side arched bridge and rocky bank with small figures crossing or standing nearby, including bridge railings, steps, cliff edge, and adjacent dark water rocks.
must_preserve: curved bridge span and railing posts
fine garment outlines on the small figures
angular rock ledges supporting the bridge
dark ink accents under the bank
short broken strokes suggesting steps and shoreline

motifs.name: central_foreground_pine_promontory
motifs.description: Isolate the dominant foreground rocky promontory with tall clustered pines, heavy trunks, interlacing roots, dark boulders, and layered pine crowns spreading left and right.
must_preserve: bold twisting pine trunks with bark texture
dense needle dots and comb-like pine sprays
interlaced root systems gripping the rocks
dark layered boulder washes
branch structure and asymmetrical canopy silhouettes

motifs.name: lower_left_travelers_animals
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left procession of travelers with pack animals on the path, including standing attendants, mounted or led animals, small dogs, and the nearby rocky ground strokes.
must_preserve: delicate figure outlines and robe folds
animal heads, legs, saddles, and reins
small dog silhouettes near the path
gestural hand and staff details
light ground lines tying the group to the path

motifs.name: lower_right_river_boats
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right river boats with seated figures, a long moored boat, nearby small craft, bank grasses, and the calm water around them.
must_preserve: thin boat hull contours and pointed ends
seated figure linework and robe shapes
oar or pole strokes where visible
reed and grass marks along the bank
soft water wash surrounding the boats

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
